planRevision.objective: Deliver visually beautiful, searchable, URL-addressable semantic cards whose motion, generated variation, verification cost, compilation cost, and learner runtime scale with genuinely new primitives and renderer topologies rather than with lessons or combinatorial presentation cases.

assumptions.statement: A human-reviewed exemplar must use shared reader and measured-motion contracts before its behavior can calibrate generated-family quality.
Adding a lesson or expression within a supported topology should require semantic data and bindings, not custom coordinates, CSS, choreography, routes, or named gates.
Primitive laws, topology contracts, manifest-driven reader conformance, covering arrays, and a small gold cohort can replace per-lesson browser and visual gate growth without reducing rigor.
The learner runtime should receive compact verified plans and check only browser-dependent facts such as font readiness, measured geometry, fit, collisions, and renderer availability.

Transformation sequence and parallelism express mathematical state changes, while together, sequential, staggered, and stepped branch schedules remain bounded presentation intent over one semantic operation.
Nested fraction distribution and normalization require stable expression subtrees and explicit normal-form intent rather than LaTeX string concatenation.

LLMs may select verified semantics, correspondence, focus, cadence, and normal-form intent while deterministic compilers retain geometry, timing, typography, responsive adaptation, rendering, and repair authority.

A corrective priority blocks rather than destroys preserved ready work; after resolution Theseus re-evaluates dependencies, priority, supersession, and new evidence instead of blindly popping a stack.

phases.title: Gold equation reader parity foundation
phases.objective: Preserve the completed searchable, scrollable, URL-addressable measured equation reader as the canonical symbolic-motion reference.

phases.title: Distribution reader and motion convergence
phases.objective: Restore shared reader behavior, development review, active TOC state, measured KaTeX endpoint geometry, token-level algebra-to-area label lineage, continuous interpolation, and true factoring choreography while preserving the accepted exact semantic trace, composition, typography, SVG scene, and searchable route; stop for human visual approval before generalization.

phases.title: Generated quality and verification amortization
phases.objective: Convert accepted exemplar repairs into shared reader conformance, dense temporal motion checks, primitive and combinator laws, topology fixtures, manifest-generated routes, impact-selected verification, promotion tiers, production-closure checks, and per-route bundle budgets so ordinary lessons add neither bespoke motion code nor named gates.

phases.title: Composable branch schedules and structured algebra
phases.objective: Add dependency-checked together, one-at-a-time, staggered, and stepped schedules over shared semantic branches; derive inverse schedules, URL and accessibility state, and narrow-layout adaptations; then replace distribution string templates with stable expression trees, role binding, verified rewrites, and typed normal-form intent.

phases.title: Fraction composition pressure test
phases.objective: Prove primitive amortization in order through opaque fraction fan-out, numerator normalization with sequential and parallel evaluation, fraction terms within distributed sums, verified reverse factoring, and a lawful multiply-both-sides, cancel, distribute, and simplify macro; add renderer work only for genuinely new topology and stop for architectural review.

phases.title: Governed semantic and LLM authoring boundary
phases.objective: Expose only stable typed semantic operations, correspondence, focus, cadence, normal-form, and pedagogical compression intent to providers and LLMs; compile deterministically or return typed repair without granting control over DOM, geometry, coordinates, arbitrary keyframes, typography, or rendering.

phases.title: Symbolic and cross-domain breadth
phases.objective: After family promotion, advance through radicals, exponents, functional wrapping, calculus, vectors, matrices, code, economics, FTC, physics, and lazy WebGL only through the accepted reader, scheduling, verification, bundle, and provider contracts.
